suggested_solution: Check GPU driver updates and install the latest version.
Verify BIOS settings to ensure they are not limiting GPU performance.
Run a stress test (e.g., Unigine Heaven or Valley) to identify any thermal or power limit issues.
Monitor GPU temperatures using software like HWiNFO, GPU-Z, or MSI Afterburner to rule out overheating as the cause of the issue.
Consider updating the cooling pad drivers and ensuring proper installation.
